research_status: Development comparison on previously used E1-E3; not independent confirmation

hyperparameters.selection: No new search for any arm
hyperparameters.rationale: Reuse the previously source-selected Y value as a fixed strength; no R target tuning

stopping.numerical_or_hash_failure: Stop and diagnose; retain failure and any deviation, no silent exclusion
stopping.external_interruption: Restore last committed epoch, optimizer and RNG; retain event trail
stopping.historical_Y_stop: Remains in effect; these are new R runs, not added Y seeds

target_gate: No new R target evaluation until every frozen source run is complete and verified

analysis.summary: Seed mean and sample SD within each environment; equal-weight mean across three environments
analysis.no_population_inference: No seed-as-environment p values or population confidence intervals
analysis.negative_results: Report every completed run and every environment, including harm

checkpoint_retention: epoch 1, each tenth epoch, two most recent epochs and selected source best
known_limitations: CUDA adaptive-max-pool backward is not strictly deterministic
Historical timestamp and phase provenance limitations remain; R uses amplitude only
This fixed-strength study does not establish the optimum of any method
